basis: Frozen A accuracy survives equal-time sham and idle, but falls from about 99% to about 52% across 16 fully learned intervening objects. Fresh one-shot learning also approaches chance after four to sixteen prior writes. This evidence was known when designing these secondary tests.

experiments.name: retention-objective
experiments.comparison: Only the final unpredictably sampled query differs: most recent versus any previously observed object. Each physical sampled reward trains the same 20-node graph and rule.
experiments.independent_confirmation: New birth IDs 811 to 816, capacity world seed 9124431, endpoint 8000.

experiments.name: lifetime-fit
experiments.comparison: Full forward and backward across multiple four-contact blocks, versus actual episodic resets at block boundaries. Tapes, budgets, initialization and clocks matched. Preserve all state in the primary carry arm.

experiments.name: credit-fit
experiments.comparison: After observing very large whole-life path gradients, compare detaching only activities/traces, only graph parameters, or both at block boundaries. Forward values remain identical and sampled historical motor/edit scores retain full future credit. Compare against unchanged carry fit.

experiments.name: context-timing
experiments.comparison: Hold physical information and five reaction ticks fixed. Compare a full simultaneous menu to two ticks of advance scene sight and three menu ticks, plus a matched blank preview. Use geometric curriculum and direct controls. Terminal sampled action alone gets a physical payout.

experiments.name: readback-fit
experiments.comparison: Allow direct local readback of weighted sender traces in the current graph. Two extra learned scalars start at zero, with zero and randomly permuted recipient controls. No additional persistent life state. All arms begin at the same 4000-step episodic checkpoint and use the same progressively lengthened curriculum.

mechanism_probes: actual component swaps and real review
real review at fixed first/last times
noisy repeated outcomes and matched evidence order
single object sign flips among eight fully crossed histories
weight-dose tradeoff at matched A start
endpoint_boundary: Exploratory tests and confirmation are labeled separately. Cross-world confidence intervals use the independent training birth rather than treating paired motor decisions as independent networks.
